temperature_2m.verdict: Air temperature at 2 m increased by about 0.26 °C per decade (1981–2025). This trend is statistically significant (p < 0.001): it is very unlikely to be just chance.

precipitation.verdict: For precipitation, the estimated change is +0.020 mm/day per decade (1981–2025), but we cannot rule out chance (p = 0.45). A longer period or a different region might reveal a clear trend.

relative_humidity_2m.verdict: For relative humidity at 2 m, the estimated change is +0.042 % per decade (1981–2025), but we cannot rule out chance (p = 0.76). A longer period or a different region might reveal a clear trend.

specific_humidity_2m.verdict: Specific humidity at 2 m increased by about 0.14 g/kg per decade (1981–2025). This trend is statistically significant (p < 0.001): it is very unlikely to be just chance.

wind_speed_10m.verdict: For wind speed at 10 m, the estimated change is −0.020 m/s per decade (1981–2025), but we cannot rule out chance (p = 0.12). A longer period or a different region might reveal a clear trend.

solar_radiation.verdict: Solar radiation at the surface increased by about 0.065 kWh/m²/day per decade (1984–2025). This trend is statistically significant (p < 0.001): it is very unlikely to be just chance.

evapotranspiration.verdict: For evapotranspiration, the estimated change is +0.024 mm/day per decade (1981–2025), but we cannot rule out chance (p = 0.071). A longer period or a different region might reveal a clear trend.

soil_wetness_root.verdict: For root zone soil wetness, the estimated change is +0.0012 fraction 0–1 per decade (1981–2025), but we cannot rule out chance (p = 0.52). A longer period or a different region might reveal a clear trend.
